## Overview

Geometry for a consumer-rendered arrow. Quartz computes numbers only — no markup, colors or
dimensions. All values describe the surface *after* flip, alignment changes and viewport
clamping, so they never refer to the requested placement.

- **Kind:** Interface
- **Source:** [packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-arrow.ts:18](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-arrow.ts#L18)

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | [`OverlayPlacement`](/docs/reference/api/core/overlay-placement) | Resolved (physical) placement after flip. `-start`/`-end` are physical, also in RTL. |
| `side` | [`OverlaySide`](/docs/reference/api/core/overlay-side) | Side of the anchor the surface sits on (`top` placement → `top`). Same as Radix `data-side`. |
| `edge` | [`OverlaySide`](/docs/reference/api/core/overlay-side) | Edge of the surface that faces the anchor and carries the arrow (`top` placement → `bottom`). |
| `alignment` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | Where the resolved placement aligns the surface to the anchor. |
| `axis` | `'x' \| 'y'` | Axis the offsets run along: `x` for top/bottom placements, `y` for left/right. |
| `offset` | `number \| null` | Px from the surface's start edge (left for `x`, top for `y`) to the arrow's start edge, i.e. the value to bind to `left`/`top`. `null` when `available` is false. |
| `centerOffset` | `number \| null` | Px from the surface's cross-axis center to the arrow's center. `null` when unavailable. |
| `available` | `boolean` | `false` when no safe arrow position exists: the arrow (plus padding) does not fit the surface edge, the anchor does not overlap the surface along the cross axis, or a measurement is not finite. Consumers should hide the arrow. Offsets are `null` then — never `NaN` or `Infinity`. |
